description: Declares which AssetSource loaders should be registered, and asset_id -> source hints. No loader was implemented in Phase W3 (registeredSources was an empty array then); Phase W6 (asset pipeline activation) shipped all four concrete loaders — see world.frontend.asset_loader.registry_factory.build_default_registry, which the Phase W8 renderer (world.frontend.renderer.asset_locator.AssetLocator) uses by default.

assetHints.description: asset_id -> which source is expected to claim it, used purely as a lookup hint; AssetRegistry.resolve() dispatches by AssetLoader.can_load(), not by this list.
